## 📋 Module Overview

This module provides an in-depth introduction to **Relational and Non-Relational Databases**, from data modelling to query optimization.

## 📚 Course Structure

::: {.callout-note}
## Module Contents
- **Chapter 1** — Introduction to Databases: Concepts & Architecture
- **Chapter 2** — Relational Model & Entity-Relationship Diagrams
- **Chapter 3** — SQL: DDL, DML, DQL, DCL
- **Chapter 4** — Normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF)
- **Chapter 5** — Transactions, ACID Properties & Concurrency Control
- **Chapter 6** — Introduction to NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra)
- **Chapter 7** — Database Administration & Query Optimization
:::
